title: Declare personas before signing in
when: Test needs authenticated behavior or more than one account
need: Declare personas and each target origin with signed-in probes in browser-control. Hosted signed-in missions set method_config.browser_identities, such as ["member"]. Named identities select managed setup, verification and steps even without installing Yoke; expired sites return a human gate naming identity, site and account. API/CLI credentials stay separate.
surface: Browser scenario method configuration → browser-identities reference.
gap: Live signed-in prod mission proof remains a release obligation.
review: Dispatch selection is covered for both mission executors, one or several identities, and missions without identities.
recipes: yoke projects capability-settings get --project P --cap-type browser-control --json
